proposed_facts.reason: Canonical DBGRead sends its command before testing length, transfers full words while the signed length is nonzero, and subtracts before clamping. DBRead rounds an unchecked unsigned size. The correction accurately preserves negative-length and overflow exceptions.

Canonical DBGWrite consumes complete words without modifying the input buffer, uses the stated address mask, and does not reject negative lengths. DBWrite's unsigned rounding provides neither overflow nor signed-range validation.

DBQueryData clears the flag unconditionally and initializes enable only when pending length is zero, yet restores interrupts outside that branch. CheckMailBox accepts the stated tag and can set the flag for a zero-length descriptor.
DBGReadStatus performs the synchronous status transfer; CheckMailBox tests bit 0 and DBWrite tests bit 1 in three polling phases surrounding payload and mailbox publication.
DBInitInterrupts is declared int and falls through without returning. The independently inspected MetroTRK caller installs this function and invokes the callback without consuming its result.
